name: Campingplatz Farmcamping Branger Alm
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Farmcamping Branger Alm campsite is located in the municipality of Unterperfuss in the Tiroler Inntal, on a sunny slope. The agricultural farm sets the tone for the site. The area is characterized by the mountainous landscape of the Stubaier Alpen and Sellraintal, offering access to hiking trails and mountain biking routes. In winter, nearby ski resorts like Axamer Lizum, Kühtai, and Muttereralm are easily reachable by car. The facilities include powered pitches with basic sanitary amenities. A farm shop sells locally produced goods from the farm’s own production. Guests stay on the active farm and use the pitches as a base for outdoor adventures.
